# Superstars Contracting — Python dependencies
# Generated by scanning all .py files in the codebase for third-party imports.
# Standard library modules (sqlite3, pathlib, json, etc.) are part of Python itself
# and are not listed here.
#
# Install on workstation with:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Recommended: do this inside a virtual environment to keep deps isolated:
#   python -m venv venv
#   venv\Scripts\activate
#   pip install -r requirements.txt

# Web framework
flask>=3.0
flask-cors>=4.0

# Production WSGI server for Windows (continuous-run task — see run_server.ps1).
# Falls back to Flask's dev server if waitress isn't installed.
waitress>=3.0

# PDF generation (HTML → PDF)
weasyprint>=60.0

# Spreadsheet read/write (used by report generators)
openpyxl>=3.1

# Data manipulation (used by lookahead/meeting generators)
pandas>=2.0

# HTTP client (used by test scripts + future API integrations)
requests>=2.31

# Email sending (used by RFI/meeting workflows)
sendgrid>=6.11

# Image handling — iPhone face photos arrive as HEIC and browsers can't
# render them; we convert HEIC → JPEG server-side on face-photo upload.
# Pillow is the engine; pillow-heif adds HEIC codec support to it.
Pillow>=11.0
pillow-heif>=1.3

# Password hashing for dashboard auth (users table). Per-user salt, no
# plaintext passwords on disk. Worker-app PIN path is unaffected — workers
# don't get accounts.
bcrypt>=4.0

# Google OIDC SSO (#261) — verifies the Google ID-token signature/iss/aud/exp
# against Google's published JWKS. Official Google library; used ONLY on the
# optional "Sign in with Google" path, which is feature-flagged OFF when the
# GOOGLE_OAUTH_* env vars are unset (the app otherwise runs exactly as today).
google-auth>=2.55

# PDF rendering library (read-only) — used by generate_credentials_batch
# to extract per-card pages as PNGs for the bundle's tiled layout, and
# to verify post-render page counts.
pypdfium2>=4.0

# PDF post-processing (read + write) — used by generate_credentials_batch
# to bake /ViewerPreferences /Duplex /DuplexFlipLongEdge into the bundle's
# catalog so print dialogs auto-pick long-edge duplex. Modern MIT-licensed
# successor to PyPDF2. Pure Python, no native deps.
pypdf>=6.0

# ===== FUTURE / NOT YET IN CODEBASE =====
# Uncomment when needed:

# opencv-python>=4.9       # for ID card / face detection (Worker Intake Phase 4)
# pdfplumber>=0.11         # for extracting text from existing roster PDFs
# pdf2image>=1.17          # PDF → image conversion for debugging
# Pillow>=10.0             # general image processing
# python-dotenv>=1.0       # load .env file (if we switch from os.environ direct)
# pysqlcipher3>=1.2        # encrypted SQLite (Tier 1 security upgrade)
psycopg[binary]>=3.1  # #259 � Postgres driver (dev/optional; SQLite remains default)

# #290 - IANA tz database for zoneinfo on hosts without a system copy
# (Windows). Load-bearing for ssc_tz's SSC_TZ validation and the tz gate
# check; already a transitive dep of pandas, pinned here explicitly so a
# lean install can never lose it.
tzdata>=2024.1

# AI extraction (cert cards, document scanner, expense scanner). The LIBRARY
# is required at import time — cert_extractor is imported by server.py at
# boot, so the app cannot start without it (the 2026-07-30 Render deploy
# failure). The API KEY stays optional: absent -> clean 503 "AI disabled".
# Hand-installed on the workstation long ago; declared as of #290.
anthropic>=1.4                # Claude: messages + Files API (client.files.upload with expiry, 2026-10-15)

# Direct jinja2 imports exist (server.py signage routes,
# generate_credentials_batch). Flask already ships Jinja2, so this never
# crashed — pinned explicitly because we import it by name, not by luck.
jinja2>=3.1

# NOT declared on purpose: zxing-cpp (import zxingcpp) — used only by
# decode_qrs.py, a standalone workstation QR-audit CLI that nothing in the
# server imports. Hand-install if you need that tool: pip install zxing-cpp

# #292 — Postgres connection POOL (warm connections; per-request connects were
# ~100-200ms each on the cloud and the parallel aggregates paid one PER PART).
# PG-path only; SQLite untouched.
psycopg-pool>=3.2

# Field-level encryption for OAuth tokens / inbox content at rest (secret_box.py).
# Official PyCA library (Fernet = AES + HMAC, authenticated). Key comes from the
# 1Password-injected SSC_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY env var — never stored on disk.
cryptography>=43.0
